title: Greeting
description: Learn how to say hello and goodbye

steps.question: What do you say in the morning?
steps.question_audio_text: What do you say in the morning?
steps.teach: In the morning, we say: Good morning!

steps.question: What do you say in the evening?
steps.question_audio_text: What do you say in the evening?
steps.teach: In the evening, we say: Good evening!
